Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog: Added active player debuffs and new Active Effects modes to Death Replay. Added 10-second, 30-second, and 1-minute Review timelines plus Heals and Timers controls. Improved timeline HP bars, redesigned Customize, reorganized Options, moved Fun Mode into the header, improved unsupported replay framing, and made Better Deaths start closed.
